name: io.github.Guoqiang1006/gomami-mcp
title: GoMami (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for managing GoMami servers, read-only by default

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: GoMami API token. Optional if the token is saved in ~/.config/gomami-mcp/token

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_MCP_ACCESS
environmentVariables.description: Access tier: read, operate or full

environmentVariables.name: GOMAMI_MCP_PROTECTED_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated server IDs that can be read but not changed
